drug_class: Biological Collection Device / Hematopoietic Stem Cell Source
purpose: This is a special sterile kit used to collect and store your baby's umbilical cord blood right after birth. The cord blood contains valuable stem cells that can be used to treat certain serious blood diseases, cancers, and immune system disorders. It acts like a biological insurance policy for your child or potentially other family members.
how_it_works: After your baby is born and the umbilical cord is cut, blood is collected from the cord into this sterile unit using a safe, painless process that does not affect you or your baby. The collected blood is rich in blood-forming stem cells, which are like master cells that can grow into different types of blood cells. These stem cells can later be transplanted into a patient to help rebuild a healthy blood and immune system if needed.
common_side_effects: There are no side effects for the baby or mother from the collection process itself. The collection is completely painless and happens after the baby is safely delivered. Rarely, there may be an insufficient amount of blood collected, which may make the sample unusable.
warnings: This kit is for collection purposes only and is not a treatment by itself. The collected cord blood must be properly processed and stored by a certified lab to remain usable. Not all collected samples will have enough stem cells for future use. Always inform your healthcare provider of your plans to collect cord blood well before your due date so everything is ready in time.
typical_dosing: This is not a medication with a dose. It is a one-time collection done at birth. Your healthcare team will handle the collection process in the delivery room. After collection, the unit is sent to a cord blood bank where it is tested, processed, and frozen for long-term storage until it may be needed.
